extDescription.message: Fill passwords from your PhylaxBox vault. Requires the PhylaxBox desktop app.

commandFill.message: Fill the login for this site

noHost.message: The PhylaxBox app is not installed on this computer, or this browser cannot reach it.

noHostHint.message: Install the PhylaxBox desktop app, then restart the browser.

noApp.message: The PhylaxBox app is not running.

noVault.message: Create your vault in the PhylaxBox app first.

pairIntro.message: Connect this browser to the PhylaxBox app. You will approve it in the app once.

pairWaiting.message: Approve the connection in the PhylaxBox app. It shows this code:

pairHint.message: If the codes differ, deny the request in the app.

unlockHint.message: The password goes to the PhylaxBox app on this computer, which unlocks the vault.

noMatches.message: No saved logins for this site. Search below.

err_app_unavailable.message: The PhylaxBox app is not running.

err_host_missing.message: The PhylaxBox app is not installed for this browser.

err_host_disconnected.message: The connection to the app was lost. Try again.

err_timeout.message: The app did not answer in time.

err_launch_failed.message: Could not start the app. Open it from the system menu.

err_corrupted.message: The vault file is damaged. Open the app to restore a backup.

err_unsupported_page.message: Logins can only be filled on http and https pages.

err_site_mismatch.message: This login belongs to another site.

err_untrusted_frame.message: The login form is in a frame from another site. It was not filled.

err_no_login_form.message: No login form found on this page.

err_page_not_accessible.message: The extension cannot fill this page.

err_pairing_denied.message: The connection was refused in the app.

err_busy.message: Too many connection requests. Try again in a moment.

err_too_many_browsers.message: Too many browsers are connected. Remove one in the app settings.

err_not_paired.message: This browser is not connected to the app.

err_auth_failed.message: The app did not recognize this browser. Connect it again.

err_app_not_trusted.message: The program answering is not your PhylaxBox app. Nothing was sent.

err_origin_not_allowed.message: This extension is not allowed by the app.

err_unsupported_protocol.message: Update the PhylaxBox app or the extension: their versions do not match.

err_clipboard_error.message: Could not copy to the clipboard.

err_no_login_data.message: Type the username and password in the page first.

err_save_expired.message: That login is no longer available. Read it from the page again.

err_password_required.message: There is no password to save.

autoSaveLabel.message: Offer to save logins when I sign in to a site

autoSaveHint.message: The browser will ask to let the extension read and change data on all sites: it needs that to notice sign-ins. Without it, use "Save this login" in the popup.

autoSaveDenied.message: Permission not granted: the option stays off.

autoSaveOn.message: On. Sign-ins on sites opened from now on are noticed.

autoSaveOff.message: Off. The extension no longer has access to all sites.

lookalikeWarning.message: Careful: this site looks like $SITES$, where you have a saved login. It may be a fake. Check the address.

saveUnchangedText.message: “$TITLE$” is already saved with this password.

mismatchWarning.message: This login was saved for $SAVED$, but this page is $PAGE$. Fill it only if you trust this page.

generatedCopied.message: New password copied. The clipboard is cleared in $SECONDS$ s.
